messages.subject: lavaan for Exploratory SEM
parts:
I am trying to conduct exploratory SEM for a hierarchical model: 6 first-oder factors and 3 second-order factors.

I know that high-order ESEM can be conducted in Mplus, but I am not sure it is possible for R. 

Can you, please, recommend any tutorial or guide on how to conduct ESEM for high-order models with lavaan package. 

Best regards, 
El
